verdict.rationale: Conta Simples' marketing says users can manage everything that happens on their corporate cards in real time. It also promises analysis by cost center, user and expense category, with payments auto-categorized by area, owner and expense type, which covers the team and category dimensions. Merchant-level views are not shown: suppliers exist only as a way to classify and reconcile expenses. The real-time claim rests on a single marketing line. Missing for 10: an explicit merchant/supplier spend breakdown, documentation of same-day transaction posting latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the real-time dashboards.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land
